decision: Jira sync must use `issuetype NOT IN (Epic)` instead of an explicit whitelist, and include a PR-key backfill pass for tickets absent from the main sweep.
key_insight: Jira instance-specific type names silently break whitelist JQL filters — this instance uses 'Sub-task' (hyphenated) not 'Subtask' (one word). Exclusion patterns are future-proof; enumeration is fragile. A post-sync backfill pass is also required to catch Done tickets and edge-case types still referenced by open PRs.
alternatives_considered: Keep whitelist and add 'Sub-task' to it
Accept orphan false-positives as noise in PR Coverage
rejected_reason: Whitelist addition is brittle — will break again on any future non-standard issuetype; exclusion is future-proof
False orphan signals erode trust in the PR Coverage view — users stop acting on signals they know are unreliable
